api_key.description: Retrieve from your OpenAI Ads dashboard (**Settings** > **API keys**). Keys are scoped to a single ad account.

reports.description: Custom reports. Each report lands in its own destination table, in addition to the prebuilt report and metadata tables that are always synced.

aggregation_level.description: The entity level the report's rows are aggregated at: AD_ACCOUNT, CAMPAIGN, AD_GROUP, or AD.

fields.description: Report fields and metrics to sync. Available fields depend on the selected aggregation level and segment.

segments.description: Use one segment at most to break the report out by: PRODUCT, COUNTRY, or DEVICE. Not allowed in combination with the hourly time granularity.

table.description: Destination table name for the report. Must be unique and can't be changed once the report is added.

time_granularity.description: The time granularity for the report's rows: NONE, HOURLY, DAILY, or MONTHLY.

items.description: Custom reports. Each report lands in its own destination table, in addition to the prebuilt report and metadata tables that are always synced.

schema.title: Destination schema name
schema.description: Destination schema name. Schema name is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation
